name: Pluck layer cascade
desc: Plucked 16th chord-tone cascade in B minor: a tight, clipped sawtooth arpeggiates Bm-G-A-D chord cells through a dotted-eighth delay so plucks and echoes interleave into a lattice. An octave-up shadow via off() fades in as variants climb. Prog's melodic engine room — busier than a pad, politer than a lead.

code.full: note("<[b3 f#3 d4 f#3] [g3 d4 b3 d4] [a3 e4 c#4 e4] [d4 a3 f#4 a3]>").struct("x*4").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.003).decay(.1).sustain(0).release(.03).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}).slow(32)).shape(.35).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(4)).off(1/2, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.35)).delay(${send}).delaytime(.375).delayfeedback(.5).room(.2).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note("<[b3 f#3 d4 f#4] [g3 d4 b3 g4] [a3 e4 c#4 a4] [d4 a3 f#4 d5]>").struct("x*8").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.003).decay(.09).sustain(0).release(.03).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).shape(.4).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).off(1/4, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.4)).every(8, x=>x.rev()).delay(${send}).delaytime(.1875).delayfeedback(.55).room(.2).orbit(4).play()
